reason: $24.99 for the first box is about 83 cents a day, and the sachet is easy to toss in my bag when I travel twice a month. The lab report is a real plus, so I'd grab one box at the launch price and see if it works for me.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to swallow, and I'm not sure magnesium will do anything for me. I'd also wait for a better deal if I thought one was coming.
